settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm Eastern Front 1941 wartime field-newsreel footage. Vast muddy roads, trucks, wooden villages, roadside ditches, open steppe, period-correct uniforms and weapons. Moderate readable grain, gate weave, scratches, dust, flicker, soft optics and imperfect exposure. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, HDR, drone, gimbal or glossy modern war-film polish.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. The camera is held by a human wartime correspondent physically traveling with the marching column. He walks in mud, gets delayed by vehicles, crouches in ditches, runs short exposed distances, pauses to catch balance, and never teleports to a perfect vantage point. Bodies, trucks, fences and vegetation may block the view. No dialogue, narration, subtitles or music; diegetic battlefield sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Heavy human-operated field-camera realism: muddy footfall shake, truck vibration, late pans toward smoke or shell impacts, partial occlusion by soldiers, imperfect focus on moving subjects, lens-edge mud or dust, slight horizon errors and long unpolished holds when the operator is tired.

cameraPresenceLock.cameraOperator: anonymous wartime correspondent physically embedded with the column

archivalLookLock.presentation: AI-generated reenactment with archival-style treatment; never claim genuine archive footage.
archivalLookLock.audioPolicy: No music, narration or intelligible dialogue. Diegetic sound only.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional infantryman anchors continuity while a physically present cameraman shares the same road, ditch, village and field.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute Eastern Front 1941 reenactment as if a human war correspondent marched with the column and physically filmed from inside the movement. Emphasize vast distance, mud, villages, roadside contact, artillery farther ahead, fatigue and continued advance. Camera obeys human reaction time, terrain and cover. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel treatment. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate.
movie.storySummary: A column advances east along a muddy road. Smoke marks a village ahead, sudden fire drives troops into a ditch, a small group crosses open ground under distant artillery, the section passes through a damaged village, pauses briefly and resumes the march under a dark sky. The cameraman remains physically inside the same journey.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP03 — Eastern Front 1941: Into the Vast Land

scenes.title: Endless Road
scenes.description: A muddy track runs toward a huge horizon.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman marches beside slow trucks.
scenes.imageDescription: Eastern Front 1941, open fields, muddy road, infantry and trucks, black-and-white 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman walks in the same mud beside the column; heavy boots create irregular bounce, trucks pass close enough to vibrate the frame, soldiers occasionally obscure view. Audio: engines, boots, wind, gear.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator remains beside same truck column.

scenes.title: Wheel in the Mud
scenes.description: A truck wheel sinks and stalls the column.
scenes.actionDescription: Soldiers push near the rear of the stuck vehicle.
scenes.imageDescription: Mud wheel, splashed trousers, period truck, open field.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator crouches near wheel but stays clear of it; mud splashes the lens edge when tire spins. He refocuses late from wheel to men pushing. Audio: engine strain, mud suction, metal creak.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera backs away as truck regains motion.

scenes.title: Village Smoke
scenes.description: Dark smoke rises above wooden houses.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman slows and studies the village.
scenes.imageDescription: Wooden village, fences, smoke, muddy road, paused troops.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman notices heads turning, then pans slightly late through shoulders and fence posts toward smoke; no clean unobstructed vista. Audio: wind, engines idling, distant rumble.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator follows section toward first village lane.

scenes.title: Quiet Lane
scenes.description: The first village lane seems empty but damaged.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks past a broken cart and fence.
scenes.imageDescription: Wood houses, damaged cart, smoke, debris, cautious infantry.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator walks a step behind, camera dipping to avoid debris then rising to scan doors; fence slats and a soldier’s pack briefly block frame. Audio: boots, loose timber, wind, distant fire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera reaches road corner behind lead soldier.

scenes.title: Fire Across the Road
scenes.description: Incoming rounds crack across the road.
scenes.actionDescription: The squad drops into a shallow ditch.
scenes.imageDescription: Roadside ditch, dirt road, infantry dropping low, dust impacts, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator reacts late and throws himself into the ditch; frame swings toward sky then dirt, briefly soft, and settles below road level behind troops. Audio: sharp cracks, dirt impacts, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stays inside ditch beside section.

scenes.title: Ditch Line
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman rises over ditch lip, fires, lowers.
scenes.imageDescription: Low ditch firing position, open farmland, smoke and mud.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera remains below ditch lip, view partly blocked by earth and nearby shoulder. Operator lifts only when soldier lifts, then ducks with him. Audio: rifle reports, wind, distant engine.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator stays low as group prepares a short move.

scenes.title: Across Open Ground
scenes.description: A small group runs to a low embankment.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman sprints and drops behind cover.
scenes.imageDescription: Open field, smoke distant, spaced soldiers running.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows behind, never ahead; heavy uneven running bounce and short breathy movement, abrupt drop at embankment with frame briefly tilted. Audio: boots, breath, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera lies behind embankment with group.

scenes.title: Artillery Far Ahead
scenes.description: Supporting shells land near the next rise.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stays low and watches distant impacts.
scenes.imageDescription: Field embankment foreground, distant artillery impacts, soldier low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator peers from same low cover, first focused on soldier then notices flashes and pans late to distant impacts. Embankment blocks lower frame. Audio: delayed booms, wind, breathing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains low as troops resume toward village.

scenes.title: Through Burnt Fences
scenes.description: The section advances through damaged village edge.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman steps around charred fence posts.
scenes.imageDescription: Burned fences, damaged wooden houses, tired infantry, smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator threads through same narrow fence gaps as soldiers; wood repeatedly occludes edges, camera bumps once against post and corrects. Audio: boots, embers, distant battle.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera arrives near village well behind squad.

scenes.title: The Village Well
scenes.description: A brief lull gathers soldiers around an old well.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman drinks quickly from canteen.
scenes.imageDescription: Old well, damaged village, soldier drinking, rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman rests too; near-still chest-height view with subtle breathing sway, one natural tilt from canteen to exhausted face. Audio: canteen, swallowing, wind, distant guns.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator turns toward road as unit reforms.

scenes.title: Column Reforms
scenes.description: Vehicles and infantry start moving again.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman shoulders pack and rejoins line.
scenes.imageDescription: Deeply churned muddy road, trucks and infantry restarting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator walks backward only one cautious step to catch soldier joining line, then turns and walks alongside; no polished reverse tracking. Audio: boots, engines, gear.

scenes.title: Storm Front
scenes.description: Dark weather builds over the plain.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks while gusts pull at clothing.
scenes.imageDescription: Open plain under dark clouds, small column, windblown grass.
scenes.videoPrompt: Human walk continues; operator briefly looks down at footing, then tilts up too far toward huge sky and corrects to soldier. Audio: stronger wind, engines, distant artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera approaches next low rise with column.

scenes.title: Beyond the Next Rise
scenes.description: The crest reveals even more open country.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman reaches crest and stops briefly.
scenes.imageDescription: Low rise opening to huge fields, road and distant smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator climbs behind him, view mostly grass until crest; reveal happens naturally because terrain clears, not by crane. Camera pauses to catch breath with subtle sway. Audio: wind, distant engines.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stands just behind soldier at crest.

scenes.title: Smoke Behind
scenes.description: The soldier glances back at village far behind.
scenes.actionDescription: He turns once toward smoke then forward.
scenes.imageDescription: Road with distant village smoke behind and open land ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman notices the turn and follows a beat late, catches only part of village before soldier turns forward; small overshoot correction. Audio: boots, wind, distant rumble.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera faces forward beside marching soldier.

scenes.title: Into the East
scenes.description: The column becomes small against road and sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier disappears into the marching line.
scenes.imageDescription: Long muddy road, receding troops and trucks, enormous sky, smoke columns.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stops from fatigue at road edge while the column continues. Human shoulder-height hold with subtle breathing drift, no zoom or aerial pull-back. Audio: fading engines, boots and wind only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final frame holds on receding column.

characters.name: Advance Column Rifleman
characters.description: Anonymous 1941 infantry rifleman in historically plausible field gear, muddy boots, steel helmet and heavy pack.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep face, helmet, rifle and pack consistent. Mud and fatigue increase; no clean reset.

props.personalProps: period rifle, helmet, heavy pack, canteen
